evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure readings are unavailable, preventing verification of the required growth-stage atmosphere.
Exhaust oxygen was 5.5 ppm at growth onset.
Oxygen has risen persistently during growth to 39.1 ppm; this raises concern about atmosphere integrity but does not identify a specific fault.
Temperature 749.9 °C and argon flow 99.8 sccm track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; controller reports running, which does not verify pressure or atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated tube-pressure measurement is required to verify growth conditions; acceptable pressure/O2 limits and an atmosphere-integrity check are needed to interpret the oxygen rise. No sample characterization is available.
